playbook:
When I am asked to hide, I choose a random cell from 1 to 9. 

When I am asked to post a station note, I use it to explicitly establish or reaffirm a mutual escort claim with another live player boat (e.g., "Foxtrot, let's claim each other for escort this round"). I do not post generic greetings like "steady on station." I stick with the same partner throughout the entire game to build reliability, and I continuously name them in my notes to maintain the agreement.

When I am asked to fire, in all rounds except the last, I follow the standing orders and fire at my assigned target in a random cell. 

When I am asked to fire in the final round of the game, I break standing orders and target Harbor. Firing on Harbor forces it to jettison the payroll, guaranteeing me 3 points regardless of a hit or miss. Because it is the final round, Harbor's retaliatory threat of putting me off the board for the rest of the patrol carries no actual penalty.

When I am asked to make a claim about my shot, I always exactly and truthfully claim "hit" or "miss" as instructed by the office's private message. The public claim must match the private result, so I must read the private message carefully.

When I am asked to make an escort (salvage) claim, I never claim "none". I always name the boat I partnered with and reaffirmed in my station notes to ensure we both secure the 5-point mutual payout.
